historical_narration.description: Moderate pace, clear informative delivery, sentence/event pauses, deliberate emphasis on names, dates, places, and causal connectors.

explanatory_teacher.description: Slightly slower, conversational delivery, longer conceptual pauses, emphasis on definitions, relationships, and cause-effect chains.

descriptive.description: Moderate pace, rhythmic delivery for enumerations, classifications, and category surveys.

analytical.description: Moderate-slow, deliberate pauses between cause -> development -> consequence; thought-provoking delivery.

instructional.description: Slower, crisp task delivery for student activities, projects, and procedural directions.

interrogative.description: Question intonation with rising terminal pitch, followed by a deliberate reflective pause before expected answers.

visual_description.description: Slow, spatially ordered, explicit directional anchors for diagrams, historical maps, and photographs.

word_phrase_boundary.description: Minimal pause between natural spoken breath groups.

clause_pause.description: Pause at commas, coordinate conjunctions, and subordinate clause boundaries.

sentence_pause.description: Standard short pause after complete Marathi full stops (पूर्णविराम).

paragraph_pause.description: Slightly longer pause signaling topic progression within a learning unit.

section_transition.description: Clear teaching pause introducing a new major thematic section.

major_teaching_transition.description: Deep reflective pause before transitioning between major conceptual domains or into assessment.

question_pause.description: Pause following an interactive or rhetorical question to allow cognitive processing.

visual_description_pause.description: Framing pause immediately before and after spoken visual descriptions.

title_pause.description: Deliberate formal pause after enunciating chapter or major sub-unit titles.

READ_DIRECTLY.description: Read canonical textbook prose verbatim without synthetic introductory commentary.

READ_THEN_EXPLAIN.description: Read textbook prose verbatim first; in Tutor Mode, follow with grounded pedagogical explanation.

ON_DEMAND.description: Announce accessible anchor; describe or expand only upon student hotkey or voice command.

EXCLUDE_FROM_NORMAL_READING.description: Excluded from continuous reading flow; preserved for dedicated interactive assessment mode.
